data.answer: Production data is deleted by dropping the customer's tenant schema and associated storage objects, while encrypted volumes are retired by deleting their encryption keys. After a contract ends, data is deleted from production systems within 30 days, and backups expire on their normal 35-day cycle so the last copy is gone no later than 35 days after production deletion.
For a Level P1 incident, which means customer data exposed or a full outage, the response time to acknowledge is within 15 minutes.
The founder is the only person who can place or release a legal hold.
A company laptop is issued with mobile device management installed and disk encryption enforced, and access by staff is limited to support and operations needs under the access control policy.
New hires must complete security awareness training within 7 days of joining. Access to production systems is not available until it is complete.

The Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is 1 hour, meaning at most one hour of data can be lost. The Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is 4 hours, meaning service is restored within four hours of a declared disaster.
Shared secrets that the departing employee had access to are rotated within 2 business days.
Nimbus Labs holds a SOC 2 Type II report and does not yet hold ISO 27001 certification, which is planned for 2027.
